name: Komplete Packaging Service
description: Komplete Packaging Service, operating as KPAK, is a contract packaging company in Grand Prairie, Texas, with a second facility in Arlington. The company was founded in 1991 and began as a small co-packer handling hand-pack work. Primary packaging services cover stand-up pouches, pillow pouches, stick packs, overwrap and cartoning, while secondary services include shrink sleeves, shrink wrap, display assembly and kitting. KPAK also offers blending, fulfillment, and frozen and refrigerated warehousing. Clients come from the cosmetics, skincare and food sectors. The operation runs about 175 packaging machines across roughly 230,000 square feet of production space, and the company lists recognition from the American Institute of Baking.
